name: Perfect Keystones
description: Adds a ring around the crosshair that tracks your class keystone: the remaining time of timed effects such as Execution Order, Blazing Piety or Adrenaline Frenzy, the stacks of effects such as Marksman's Focus, Warp Siphon or Redline Capacitors with a warning colour before the next stack expires, build-up resources before an activation, Until Death's protection and cooldown and Lone Wolf's next Blitz charge. A thin outer ring shows Until Death or Lone Wolf next to your main keystone. Visual only: buffs, cooldowns and inputs are never changed.
author: LucLeto
